messages:
alex: Heads-up: scheduling a delta schema deploy tonight 23:00 UTC (wave1 23:00-23:15, wave2 23:30-23:45). Changes: add column event_attrs (jsonb) + a CONCURRENT index + streaming backfill. Plan is staged apply with 5% tenant batch first. Any blockers?

maria: What's the expected lock/time and rollback plan? last time a backfill caused a 40s p95 relation hold.

jin: Migration details: ADD COLUMN event_attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}' (fast, no table rewrite). Index is GIN concurrent: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_event_attrs_gin ON events USING gin (event_attrs); Backfill job name: event_attrs_backfill_v2. It's batched and supports concurrency throttling.

alex: Plan: 1) ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with default (should be instant) 2) kick off backfill job with concurrency=4 and tenant batching 5% 3) create CONCURRENT index after initial backfill pass. If anything looks off we stop backfill and roll flag.

alex: Command snippets I'll run for visibility:

```sql
-- add column (fast)
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}';

-- create index (concurrent)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_event_attrs_gin ON events USING gin (event_attrs jsonb_path_ops);
```

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled migration 'mig-2026-03-23-event-attrs' -> canary on staging @ 2026-03-23T22:00Z, prod wave1 @ 2026-03-23T23:00Z. Canary passed on staging will auto-signal. Abort window: react :x: within 10m of canary or use `/deploybot abort mig-2026-03-23-event-attrs`.

lisa: Will this need release notes? I can draft a short blurb.

ops-bot: Reminder: add DB lock watch alarm. If any relation lock > 30s during migration, pause backfill and notify #oncall.

jin: Also, recommend pinning service version to v2.14.1 for wave1 to ensure write-path compatibility with new column defaults. We can unpin after validation.

alex: Agree — we'll pin for 2 hours after wave2 completes, then unpin. Also adding a feature flag `event_attrs_enable` so we can flip off fast if needed.

maria: Rollback decision matrix proposal: abort if any of the following during waves: write p95 latency > 200ms, error rate > 0.5% for writes, or held locks > 60s. Abort action = disable feature flag + stop backfill jobs + raise rollback incident and pin older service version. Sound good?

jin: +1. Also fallback if CONCURRENT index creation fails: drop the partial index attempt, continue without index (slower queries), and schedule an offline index in a maintenance window if needed.

deploybot: Canary run on prod-staging finished: no lock events, smoke tests passed, backfill simulated on sample tenants. Ready to proceed to prod wave1 at 23:00 UTC.

alex: I'm on pager 22:50–00:30. I'll only start wave2 after wave1 is stable for 15m. @maria you own the metrics watch.

maria: ACK. I'll run this quick lock watch query every 2m and post if anything shows up:

```sql
SELECT pid, relation::regclass, mode, granted, query, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration
FROM pg_locks JOIN pg_stat_activity ON pg_locks.pid = pg_stat_activity.pid
WHERE relation::regclass::text = 'events' AND granted = false;
```

ops-bot: Added temporary alert rule: `migration.events.lock_watch` -> trigger if any lock > 30s. Pager duty route = #oncall + maria.

jin: I'll reduce backfill concurrency to 4 workers and set batch_size=5000. Updating job config now.

alex: Updated job config on the scheduler: concurrency=4, batch_size=5000, tenant_batch=5%. Deploybot acknowledged schedule update. Starting wave1 in 10m.

deploybot: wave1 started (canary tenants = 3). Monitoring in #prod-events-monitor. Good luck :rocket:

deploybot: wave1 completed at 23:12 UTC. Backfill processed ~1.2M rows. Max observed lock = 22s. No index errors. Holding 15m observation window before wave2.

maria: Observed a small latency blip at 23:05 (write p95 +35ms) — within acceptable threshold. No error-rate spike.

lisa: Drafted release note: "Add event_attrs JSONB column to events, safe backfill with feature flag and index added concurrently. Service pinned during rollout; unpin scheduled after validation." I'll add link once final.

alex: Wave2 go at 23:32. Tagging #prod-events-monitor and @ops.

deploybot: wave2 started.

deploybot: wave2 success at 23:46 UTC. Final metrics: index concurrent build time ~12m, backfill total rows ~3.9M, max lock observed 28s, write p95 within target. Unpin scheduled 01:30 UTC.

alex: Thanks team. I'll file a short deploy note and postmortem if anything odd comes up. Great coordination.

lisa: I'll publish release notes and mention the temporary pin + feature flag rollback instructions.

ops-bot: Cleanup tasks queued: remove temp alert at 02:00 UTC, disable canary tag, archive job config patch.

alex: Closing thread. If anyone sees anomalies overnight ping me on the pager.
